name: Hyperbolic Currents
description: Helmholtz flow on a hyperbolic plane inside H3: v = grad phi + J grad psi from smoothed hyperbolic Green kernels (2 sources, 2 sinks, 3 vortices drifting slowly). The plane is a field map - color = scalar potential, flow net of equipotentials and true streamlines (total stream function), advected dye and particle trails - seen from an orbiting camera, receding to the ideal boundary. 64 particles live in a rgba32f Feedback (RK4 advection, respawn at sources) and are sphere-traced as hyperbolic spheres merged with smin, glassy and glowing, pooling into liquid blobs at the sinks. Multi-pass post: render targets, two-level bloom, chromatic aberration, vignette, grain. Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Flow, Particles, Trails, Look, Post and Music.

data.text:
# Hyperbolic Currents
Helmholtz flow on a hyperbolic plane inside H³: v = ∇φ + J∇ψ from smoothed hyperbolic Green kernels (2 sources, 2 sinks, 3 drifting vortices). Color = potential, with equipotentials, streamlines, advected dye and 64 glassy particles pooling at the sinks.
Reacts to music: open the audio menu → Mic (a front of light sweeps from the sources into the sinks on every beat).
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P (or the sliders button in the top bar): Flow, Particles, Trails, Look, Post and Music settings with pretty names; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Particle Sim
The particles live in an rgba32f Feedback texture: each frame HelmholtzParticles reads the previous state, advects every particle with RK4 and respawns it at a source when its lifetime ends.

## Flow Canvas
An rgba16f Feedback buffer accumulates dye: particle trails drawn over the faded previous frame.

## Scene (H³ Raymarch)
HyperbolicCurrents raymarches the plane in H³ from an orbiting camera: field-map colors, flow net, the dye canvas, and the particles sphere-traced as hyperbolic spheres merged with smin.

## Render Targets
The graded frame (ACES, saturation) and a bright pass (two Feedback buffers) for chromatic aberration and bloom.

## Bloom
Two blur radii of the bright pass, weighted and added.

## Post FX
Chromatic aberration on the graded frame, bloom added, then vignette and grain.

## Music
Audio level gates everything: with the audio off or silent, drive = 0 and the piece looks exactly as before. drive = music × smoothstep(level).
- Beat: inside Hyperbolic Currents, an equipotential front of light sweeps from the sources into the sinks over each beat, brightening the streamlines it crosses.
- Beat: particle glow (spheres, halos, floor light) flares up to +60% (BeatEnvelope ad).
- Bass: vortex strength swells up to +30% in the sim, the dye canvas and the map.
Beat-phase couplings (the equipotential front inside Hyperbolic Currents, particle glow flare) are also multiplied by the beat tracker's confidence (Beat.confidence = u_beatConfidence: 0 with the audio off, ~1 once the beat locks, 1 with the metronome) and run on the stable beat clock with its certainty gate (Beat.gate / BeatEnvelope gate: fade, u_beatTrust): after a track change the clock holds the old tempo, then glides to the new one without jumps, and these couplings fade out until the new beat is trusted. Level and band couplings (bass vortex swell) are not.

data.label: Particles
data.description: Number of glassy particles (up to 64).

data.label: Flow speed
data.description: How fast particles and dye are advected.

data.label: Source strength
data.description: Strength of the two sources.

data.label: Sink strength
data.description: Strength of the two sinks.

data.label: Vortex strength
data.description: Strength of the three drifting vortices (J grad psi).

data.label: Kernel core
data.description: Smoothing radius of the Green kernels.

data.label: Lifetime
data.description: Average particle lifetime in seconds before respawning at a source.

data.label: Sphere size
data.description: Radius of the particle spheres.

data.label: Arc height
data.description: How high particles hop above the plane along their path.

data.label: Blob smoothing
data.description: Smooth-min radius merging particles with each other and the plane.

data.label: Streamlines
data.description: Number of streamlines in the flow net.

data.label: Particle glow
data.description: Glow of spheres, halos and floor light.

data.label: Fog
data.description: Hyperbolic distance fog toward the ideal boundary.

data.label: Camera orbit
data.description: Orbit speed of the camera.

data.label: Trail fade
data.description: Seconds for dye and trails to fade.

data.label: Trail width
data.description: Width of the particle trails on the canvas.

data.label: Source colour
data.description: Colour at the sources (low potential).

data.label: Sink colour
data.description: Colour at the sinks (high potential).

data.label: Flow-line colour
data.description: Colour of the streamlines.

data.label: Bloom
data.description: Tight bloom level.

data.label: Bloom wide
data.description: Wide bloom level.

data.label: Music reactivity
data.description: 0 = ignore the music. A front of light sweeps into the sinks on each beat; vortices swell on the bass.
